name: Monk
prompt: Create a fresh WIDE 16:9 full-screen narrative game illustration, not a pose-sheet character pasted in a background. Reference 1 is COSTUME, FACE and IDENTITY ONLY; DO NOT imitate its front-facing stance, limb arrangement, wide-legged silhouette or camera. Reference 2 gives the exact current game environment/painting style; reference 3 gives simple original ink/shape language. Restrained olive/brown/gray/ochre, bold selective black outlines and big flat shadow planes, compact stylized anatomy; no realistic or anime redesign, no dense triangular skin facets. The character belongs physically to the setting: feet share its perspective, weight is supported, limbs answer a concrete action, cloth hangs from shoulders/waist and responds to gravity. No floating thighs or disconnected pelvis. Natural three-quarter camera at chest height, no giant crotch/thigh foreshortening. Main character occupies right 60%, head near (70%,25%), left 35% quiet dark scene for live text and bottom 20% quieter scenery for live UI. Entire canvas is an illustrated environment, no UI/text/border. Scene: the blindfolded monk is carefully crossing a fractured narrow stone walkway in the ruined cloister. Seen from three-quarter side, he leans forward a LITTLE in a believable walking step, one foot securely planted on the near stone and the trailing leg pushing off behind. His bandaged hand gently rests against the upright broken wall on the RIGHT to feel his route; the other hand holds the existing large wooden wrist beads quietly near his chest. His head turns slightly to listen into the darkness, expression resolute and calm. The action is 'finding his way by touch', NOT a martial-arts demonstration or squat. Keep the same bald head, ochre blindfold and short tails, olive one-shoulder wrap, rust sash, loose dark trousers, bare feet; use restrained original anatomy without carving every muscle. Diagonal walkway and wall lead through the scene and interact with him. Do not copy the old raised-palm front pose.
